## What is the Hiddify app? The Hiddify app is a free, open-source and ad-free proxy and VPN client for **Android, iOS, Windows, macOS and Linux**. It is built on [sing-box](https://github.com/SagerNet/sing-box) and works with almost every protocol and subscription format, so you can use it with any proxy panel, including [Hiddify Manager](https://github.com/hiddify/Hiddify-Manager).
## 🚀 Main features - ✈️ **One app on every device:** Android (phones and Android TV), iOS, Windows, macOS and Linux. - 🎁 **Free profiles:** connect without a server of your own with the built-in free WARP and Psiphon profiles. - 🟡 **Many protocols:** VLESS, VMess, Trojan, Reality, Shadowsocks, Hysteria2, TUIC, WireGuard, SSH, AnyTLS and more, with the latest [Xray-core](https://github.com/XTLS/Xray-core) and sing-box features such as [VLESS encryption](https://github.com/hiddify/hiddify-sing-box/blob/v5/docs/hiddify/features/protocols/vless-encryption.en.md). - 🔗 **Every subscription format:** sing-box, V2Ray (Base64 or plain links), Clash and Clash Meta, with automatic subscription updates. - 🔍 **Automatic server choice:** the app tests every server and picks the fastest one; you can also choose a server yourself. - 🛡 **Extra security and proxy unblocker** options for countries with strong filtering, with ready rules for Iran, China, Russia and other regions. - 🔀 **VPN or proxy mode,** per-app routing on Android, and connection sharing with other devices on your network. - 📊 **Profile details:** remaining days and data for each subscription. - 🌍 **30 languages,** dark and light themes. - 💻 **[HiddifyCli](https://hiddify.com/app/HiddifyCli-guide/)** for servers and computers without a desktop. - ⭐ **Open source, secure and community driven,** available on the official stores. ## 🛍️ Get it on the stores          ## 📥 Direct download Files from the [latest release](https://github.com/hiddify/hiddify-app/releases/latest):

## ⚙️ Installation and tutorials Step-by-step guides for every device, with pictures, are on our website: - [How to install the Hiddify app](https://hiddify.com/app/How-to-install-Hiddify-app/) (Android, iPhone, Windows, macOS, Linux) - [How to use the Hiddify app](https://hiddify.com/app/How-to-use-Hiddify-app/) (add a profile, connect, choose a server, settings) - [All app tutorials and videos](https://hiddify.com/app/)
## 🌎 Translations The app is available in 30 languages. You can improve a language or add a new one by editing the JSON files in [`assets/translations`](assets/translations) or with the [Inlang online editor](https://fink.inlang.com/github.com/hiddify/hiddify-app) [![Translate with Inlang](https://img.shields.io/badge/%20-%20-3ECF8E?logo=i18next&logoColor=white)](https://fink.inlang.com/github.com/hiddify/hiddify-app). ## ✏️ Acknowledgements We sincerely thank the contributors of these projects; their solid foundation and features made this app possible: - [sing-box](https://github.com/SagerNet/sing-box) - [Xray](https://github.com/XTLS/Xray-core) - [sing-box for Android](https://github.com/SagerNet/sing-box-for-android) - [sing-box for Apple](https://github.com/SagerNet/sing-box-for-apple) - [Clash](https://github.com/Dreamacro/clash) - [Clash Meta](https://github.com/MetaCubeX/Clash.Meta) - [FClash](https://github.com/Fclash/Fclash) - [Vazirmatn font by Saber Rastikerdar](https://github.com/rastikerdar/vazirmatn) - [Others](./pubspec.yaml) ## 🎯 Donation and support The easiest way to support us is to give this repository a star (⭐) at the top of this page.
We also need financial support for our services. All our work is voluntary, and every donation goes to the development of the project. See our [donation page](https://hiddify.com/donation-and-support/). ## 👩‍🏫 Collaboration and contact Hiddify is a community-driven project. If you'd like to contribute, please read the [contribution guidelines](./CONTRIBUTING.md). We especially welcome help with **Flutter, Go, iOS development (Swift) and Android development (Kotlin)**.
